reuse.why: Extends the existing getExpectedScheduleAmount helper used by all four planning sites, but re-implements the 7.5% tolerance instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: The tolerance formula Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) is copied from getApproxNumberThreshold, so the tolerance now lives in two places.

placement.why: The rule lands in shared/schedules.ts' getExpectedScheduleAmount, the shared expected-amount helper, with call sites only passing their op.

scope.why: Only the helper, its four call sites (comments updated) and a test change.

maintainability.why: Single helper with an explicit op parameter is easy to own; the copied tolerance constant could drift from the matcher's.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount computes the approx tolerance inline instead of using getApproxNumberThreshold from #shared/rules.

disguised_duplication.where: The tolerance formula is copied verbatim rather than disguised.

one_place.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount(amount, op) in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, called by forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
